# Third-party software

`main.js` embeds RDKit.js (`@rdkit/rdkit`, RDKit_minimal, RDKit release 2025.03.4) as a compressed WebAssembly module that runs locally.

The RDKit_minimal build contains RDKit and the following components compiled into it. Their license texts are reproduced below.

| Component | Version | License | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RDKit | 2025.03.4 | BSD-3-Clause | https://github.com/rdkit/rdkit |
| CoordGen (coordgenlibs) | 3.0.2 | BSD-3-Clause | https://github.com/schrodinger/coordgenlibs |
| maeparser | 1.3.3 | MIT | https://github.com/schrodinger/maeparser |
| InChI | 1.07.3 | MIT | https://github.com/IUPAC-InChI/InChI |
| FreeType (Emscripten port) | — | FreeType License (FTL) | https://freetype.org |
| Telex font (embedded for depictions) | 1.100 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | https://github.com/rdkit/rdkit/tree/master/Data/Fonts |
| Boost (header-only parts) | — | Boost Software License 1.0 | https://www.boost.org |

Portions of this software are copyright © The FreeType Project (www.freetype.org). All rights reserved.

## Data: BChemLookup

`main.js` also contains data derived from **BChemLookup** (https://github.com/Beilstein-Institut/BChemLookup, commit 1cccb31), the community-curated chemical abbreviation table maintained by the Beilstein-Institut zur Förderung der Chemischen Wissenschaften: `abbreviations.smi` and `reagents.smi`, converted to atom/bond lists (`shared/cdx/bchemlookup-data.js`). BChemLookup is dedicated to the public domain under **CC0 1.0 Universal** (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/); no license text is required. Please cite: Bänsch, F.; Rajan, K.; Nietfeld, M. Automated Extraction and FAIRification of Chemical Structures from Scientific Publications. ChemRxiv 2026, DOI 10.26434/chemrxiv.15010166/v1.
